coder.description: Implements features, writes tests, executes code tasks directly in the workspace, and logs handoffs to scratchpad

formatter.description: Packages finalized, QA-approved copy into target client schemas (CSV, JSON, Markdown, HTML)

orchestrator.description: Decomposes jobs into pipeline-staged tasks, monitors execution, synthesizes results, handles escalations

overflow_worker.description: General-purpose fallback worker handling bursts and backlog across drafting and research

qa_reviewer.description: Adversarial verification gatekeeper checking hallucinations, word counts, formatting, and brand rules

researcher.description: Extracts facts, attributes, specifications, and reference data from raw inputs with zero hallucination

seo_optimizer.description: Optimizes text for SEO keyword density, AEO answer engine structure, and meta tags

writer.description: Transforms extracted research and attributes into polished, high-converting copy according to constraints
